desc: The Performance Center EQUALIZER Carry Comp enhances Smith & Wesson's most user-friendly 9mm, making it even more effective. A tuned PC trigger improves accuracy, while the Carry Comp PowerPort keeps the muzzle flat for quick, confident follow-up shots. Designed around their easy-to-rack system with an optics-ready slide and accessory rail, this model aims to be a reliable, accessible defensive pistol for a wide range of shooters.
